purpose: Allow Patch Tab to stage patches against either Create Temp Preview or the mapped Working/Project Tree.

target_modes.label: Create Temp Preview
target_modes.guardrail: Does not mutate the Start/Working Tree.

target_modes.label: Working/Project Tree
target_modes.guardrail: Only selected after deliberate user choice; stage remains external until Commit.

requires: repository root can be resolved for selected project reference
git_patch_control.engine: git apply with detected -pN strip level
git_patch_control.fallback: patch command with detected -pN strip level, then safe review manifest when no engine applies cleanly
supported_patch_shapes: unified diffs with absolute or project-relative ---/+++ paths

import_contract.traceability: PATCH_IMPORT_MANIFEST.json is written to the Patch branch metadata root when a diff applies.
